internal.title: Incident Resolved: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service
internal.body:
At 11:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate (25%) in the cart service. Initial diagnosis rounds considered multiple hypotheses including error injection and latency issues within the cart service, as well as no fault in the checkout service. After thorough investigation, the root cause was identified as an internal error injection in the cart service.

Actions were taken to disable the cartFailure flag at 11:19:55 UTC, which led to a verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels (0.002). The incident was resolved promptly following these corrective actions.

Timeline highlights:
- 11:00:03 UTC: Alert received for high error rate in cart
- 11:19:46 UTC: Diagnosis concluded no evidence for bad deploy or resource exhaustion
- 11:19:51 UTC: Error injection hypothesis confirmed
- 11:19:55 UTC: Flag disabled and recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
